title: import_resume_output
description: Structured content transcribed from the plain text of a candidate's existing resume. Every value is copied verbatim from the source; use an empty string or empty array when the resume does not state something.

general_info.description: Contact and identity details literally printed on the resume, usually in the header.

preferred_name.description: Only when the resume shows a nickname, e.g. 'Robert "Bob" Smith'.

address2.description: Apartment or unit, only when printed.

linkedin.description: LinkedIn URL or handle exactly as printed.

website.description: Personal site or portfolio URL. Not LinkedIn, not GitHub.

github.description: GitHub URL or handle exactly as printed.

experience.description: Jobs, internships and research positions, plus clubs, volunteering and leadership roles (which take category 'other').

end.description: End date, e.g. 'Aug 2024', or 'Present' when ongoing.

bullets.description: One entry per bullet in the source, verbatim, with the leading glyph or dash stripped.

skills.description: Technologies named inside this entry. Empty array when none are named.

category.description: 'relevant' for professional, technical or research work; 'other' for leadership, clubs, societies and volunteering.

url.description: Link printed with the project. Empty string when none.

end.description: Graduation date; may be in the future.

gpa.description: Exactly as printed, e.g. '3.9/4.0'. Empty string when absent.

courses.description: Relevant coursework listed under this school.

grade.description: Only when printed next to the course. Usually an empty string.

awards.description: Honors, scholarships, competition placings and certifications.

issuer.description: Awarding organization. Empty string when not stated.

skills.description: Flat list of individual skill names from the skills section. Never grouped and never a category label: split 'Languages: Python, Go' into 'Python' and 'Go'.

hobbies.description: Interests or hobbies, one per entry.
